title: Classes for skill, attention, and connection.
intro: Learn in a supportive environment where technique, consent, and communication are taught together.

classes.title: Beginner Foundations
classes.description: Learn core rope handling, communication, simple ties, and safety practices in a supportive beginner-friendly setting.

bringText: Comfortable clothing that allows movement, water, a notebook if you like, and any rope you already own.
Loaner rope availability can be added here once class logistics are finalized.

safetyText: Students are expected to participate with respect, sobriety, clear consent, and care for their own and their partner's limits. Suspension and advanced risk topics are not included unless explicitly listed for a class.
